attributes.description: Workload health for Google BigQuery from GCP Cloud Monitoring via OpenTelemetry (metrics-gcp.bigquery.otel-*). Organised around the BigQuery golden signals: slot capacity and saturation, query demand, query cost (bytes billed), ingestion, and storage. BigQuery is serverless, so these are workload signals, not host signals. No query latency or failed-job metrics exist in this data source.

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.bigquery.otel-*
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "bigquery_project"
| STATS allocated = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.bigquery.googleapis.com/slots/allocated`)) WHERE attributes.reservation IS NOT NULL AND attributes.reservation != "", baseline = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.bigquery.googleapis.com/slots/assigned`)), ceiling = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.bigquery.googleapis.com/slots/max_assigned`)) BY @timestamp = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS allocated = MAX(allocated), baseline = MAX(baseline), ceiling = MAX(ceiling) BY @timestamp = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.bigquery.otel-*
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "bigquery_project"
| STATS allocated = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.bigquery.googleapis.com/slots/allocated`)) WHERE attributes.reservation IS NOT NULL AND attributes.reservation != "", baseline = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.bigquery.googleapis.com/slots/assigned`)), ceiling = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.bigquery.googleapis.com/slots/max_assigned`)) BY @timestamp = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS allocated = MAX(allocated), baseline = MAX(baseline), ceiling = MAX(ceiling) BY @timestamp = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Peak per-minute slots allocated through reservations in each interval, against the reservation baseline and the autoscale ceiling (baseline plus autoscale maximum). Allocation sitting on the ceiling for 15-30 minutes means the autoscaler is maxed out and jobs queue for slots; usage between baseline and ceiling is billed autoscale capacity. On-demand usage is excluded because it has no reported capacity (see Slots allocated by job type). Empty for projects that only use on-demand pricing.
embeddableConfig.title: Reserved slot usage vs capacity

query.esql:

embeddableConfig.description: Average slots allocated per minute in each interval, stacked by job type (query, load, copy, extract). Averaged over the minutes with slot activity, so idle job types count as zero. Shows which workload is consuming capacity.
